events.csv.t0: UTC time of first slot meeting the new-cold-object criterion (initiation reference time)
events.csv.t0_index: int: index on the regular satellite time axis
events.csv.lat/lon: float deg: centroid of the object at t0
events.csv.n_pixels_t0 / min_bt_t0_k: object size and coldest BT at t0
events.csv.label: true_ci | false_ci | ambiguous | unknown | excluded_missing_history
events.csv.core_reached: bool|null: outcome (a), BT core criterion within the outcome window
events.csv.max_precip_mm_h: float: max observed IMERG estimate in the footprint/window

samples.csv.event_id, t0, lead_min, t_forecast: t_forecast = t0 - lead_min; ALL predictors have valid time <= t_forecast
samples.csv.lat, lon, label, y: y = 1 for true_ci else 0; only true_ci/false_ci events are sampled
samples.csv.valid_sat / valid_precip / valid_era5 /: bool per-source validity; features are NaN where invalid
samples.csv.sat_*: SEVIRI IR10.8 footprint statistics and 30/60-min trends (K)
samples.csv.pr_*: last completed IMERG-estimate window(s) before t_forecast (mm/h); pr_window_end_age_min = t_forecast - window end
samples.csv.era5_*: latest hourly ERA5 with valid time <= t_forecast; era5_age_min = age at forecast time (0-59)
